ns2:section.sectionText: This section is for non-majors only. There are a limited number of seats available for students with junior or senior standing. The remainder are for freshmen and sophomores. If the seats allotted for your class level are full, you may have better success after August 25. College of Communications majors and pre-majors and Agricultural Communications majors should register for Section X (CRN 45375)
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for College of Media.
